question: In a certain code language, HIDDEN is written as IJECDM. How will FELLOW be written as in that language ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6d2d1636fa4c7845923bd29b6af196ccb2686a00ce508be7afc6676a11fbbcc.png] 

HIDDEN is written as IJECDM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/979f0e14ea3bfe05c638d2184d4b623581192fba053fa9625aee43d239cedf21.png] 

Similarly,

FELLOW will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24fa4beea91b7711ae839894e87546c5324fb9306d9a255f6254113e010f4cf3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"GFMKNV".**
